title: betula odorata var. alpestris
intro: Betula odorata var. alpestris, commonly known as the Alpine Birch, is a variety of birch tree that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Betula odorata var. alpestris include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include betulin, betulinic acid, and salicin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
